p6_b0.ocr: In recent years, the adoption of Learning Management Systems (LMS) has become increasingly critical for institutions aiming to expand their international student enrollment.

p6_b2.ocr: As highlighted in Table 1, the overall growth rate for LMS adoption among international students has shown significant progress, particularly with metrics indicating a 50% increase in usage. This rise corresponds to a notable revenue impact, with projected earnings reaching $500K for the current year.

p6_b3.ocr: Furthermore, the total users of the platform have expanded, with the 35% metric reflecting a user base of 2000, underlining the growing reliance on digital education tools.
